description:
Re-package of org.eclipse.microprofile.health:microprofile-health-api with an explicit
        module-info.class (module name: microprofile.health.api). The official API only ships an
        Automatic-Module-Name, which prevents its direct use with jlink. This artifact is the sole
        source of the MP Health spec consumed by the Knock modules; the official TCK keeps using
        the upstream API.

        No upstream source file is vendored in this repository: the official .class files are
        unpacked from the upstream binary jar at build time, and the only source we own and compile
        is module-info.java. The upstream META-INF/LICENSE and META-INF/NOTICE are propagated
        verbatim into the produced jar, as required by Apache-2.0 section 4.
